scope: Date and typed-connection audit for native atlas. Reports, release logs and announcements are different events; none is silently equated with first checkpoint availability. Existing model mechanism evidence remains in the page and prior records.
note: Lanes are overlapping design themes, not ancestry. Solid arrows show family/design updates; dashed arrows show explicit checkpoint initialization. Dates identify the cited report revision, release log or announcement, not necessarily first weight availability. Time columns are unequal periods, not a proportional scale.

models.label: SmolDocling
models.idea: Compact visual tokens and DocTags preserve content, structure and location.

models.label: Granite Docling
models.idea: Docling design successor with SigLIP2 and a Granite decoder; this is not a claim of inherited weights.

models.label: DeepSeek-OCR 1
models.idea: A local-to-global vision encoder compresses a page into a short visual sequence.

models.label: DeepSeek-OCR 2
models.idea: Causal-flow queries organize visual evidence before the decoder reads it.

models.label: Unlimited-OCR
models.idea: R-SWA keeps the visual reference while bounding generated-output history.

models.label: Unlimited-OCR 2
models.idea: Sparse visual access and overlapping page chunks separately control attention and resident KV.

models.label: MinerU2.5
models.idea: Global layout on a thumbnail routes high-resolution regions to recognition.

models.label: GLM-OCR
models.idea: Layout-routed recognition or direct KIE, with shared multi-token prediction heads.

models.label: MinerU-Diffusion
models.idea: Parallel block diffusion changes target decoding; the MinerU name alone does not establish weight ancestry.

models.label: MinerU2.5-Pro
models.idea: Retain the 2.5 architecture while expanding curation and progressive training.

models.label: PaddleOCR-VL 1.6
models.idea: Target under-optimized regions with a data engine and staged post-training.

models.label: HPD-Parsing
models.idea: A layout branch coordinates parallel content branches and progressive multi-token prediction.

models.label: OXR-1.0
models.idea: Replaceable layout, recognition/order branches and a targeted post-training data loop.

models.label: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0
models.idea: Layout-first parsing or direct field extraction, with optional DSpark draft decoding.

models.label: olmOCR 2
models.idea: Executable document unit tests reward selected content, order and structural properties.

models.label: LightOnOCR-2
models.idea: Distilled data, localization rewards and checkpoint merging target compact page conversion.

models.label: HunyuanOCR-1.5
models.idea: Native-resolution reading, a compressed visual interface and DFlash decoding support unified OCR tasks.

models.label: Nemotron Parse 2.0
models.idea: C-RADIO vision features feed a cross-attending mBART decoder with typed output and locations.

models.label: TeleOCR
models.idea: Deformation-aware learning and content/structure decoupling address difficult capture; earlier indexing used NaviDC.

models.label: WeVisDoc
models.idea: Coverage training is followed by held-out residual diagnosis and targeted data/token allocation.

models.label: Xiaomi-OCR-0
models.idea: Q-Mask, curated data and mixed-task RL connect parsing with KIE/VQA; headline parsing includes a layout detector.

models.label: LightOnOCR-3
models.idea: A family update adds grounded regions, image descriptions and chart data; backbones differ by size.

models.label: OCRia-1
models.access: Hosted in LlamaParse; public weights unverified
models.idea: Structured rewards target table/header associations, chart values and formatting; no output boxes.

models.label: dots.mocr
models.idea: Eligible graphics become renderable SVG alongside text, tables and formulas.

models.label: Youtu-Parsing-Omni
models.idea: A shared perception encoder and schema ground document, image, audio and video content.

models.label: MiniCPM-OCR Jev
models.idea: Score an original crop, candidate text and rendered candidate. This verifies OCR rather than generating it.

relations.label: Docling design successor
relations.note: IBM describes an evolution of SmolDocling with new vision and language backbones; no direct weight-inheritance claim.

relations.label: DeepSeek-OCR family update
relations.note: Second generation changes the visual encoder and reading-flow design.

relations.label: Initialized from DeepSeek-OCR
relations.note: Section4.2 starts from the DeepSeek-OCR checkpoint, freezes DeepEncoder and trains the language model.

relations.label: Initialized from Unlimited-OCR
relations.note: Section4.2 initializes from Unlimited-OCR and post-trains with SR-SWA.

relations.label: MinerU2.5 architecture retained
relations.note: The Pro report retains the2.5 architecture and changes the data engine and progressive training.

relations.label: LightOnOCR family update
relations.note: The1B retains the preceding architecture;0.8B and4B adopt Qwen3.5. Family succession is not uniform weight ancestry.
